description:
In repos/activity-api/src/services/endpoint-shape-recovery.ts create a new pure module (no I/O, no database access) that derives endpoint output shapes for a goal execution pathway from what its executions observably produced.

Export exactly three things:

1. `export const SATISFIER_PREFIX = 'satisfier:'`

2. `export function observedShapesByActivity(rows: Array<{ activity_id: string; output_impulse_shapes: string[] | null }>): Map<string, Set<string>>` — group the rows by activity_id, count how many rows each shape appears in per activity, and keep only shapes appearing in at least half of that activity's rows. Rows whose output_impulse_shapes is null or empty still count toward the activity's denominator.

3. `export function deriveEndpointShapes(pathActivities: string[], observed: Map<string, Set<string>>): { shapes: string[]; provenance: 'satisfier' | 'observed' | 'mixed' | 'none' }` — walk the pathway ids and union two sources: an id beginning with `satisfier:` contributes the text after the prefix as a shape directly (skip it if that text is empty), and any other id contributes the observed set for that activity if one exists. Return the union sorted alphabetically. Provenance is 'satisfier' if every contributing id was a satisfier, 'observed' if every contributing id was a real activity, 'mixed' if both contributed, and 'none' when the union is empty.

Why this exists: `goal_execution_paths.endpoint_output_shapes` is the index the shape-signature donor query reads (`WHERE endpoint_output_shapes CONTAINSANY $target_shapes`), so a pathway with an empty array is invisible as a donor. The existing `accumulateEndpointShapes` derives from what activities *declare*, which was measured against recorded truth to produce a superset — a shape the pathway never produced — in about a third of cases; deriving from observed output produced zero supersets over 853 controlled cases. A subset label can only miss a donor, but a superset label manufactures a wrong one, so this module must never emit a shape that was not either observed or named by a satisfier id.

Use no imports. Keep it under 90 lines.
